title: Avalanche source settings
description: Reads subtitles in games on Avalanche Studios' engine (Mad Max): the ID of the line a subtitle shows, through a pointer chain found with a tool like Cheat Engine, and its text in the input language from the game's files.

pointers.description: One pointer chain per supported build of the game, ending at the 32-bit ID of the line the subtitle shows (0 when none).

exe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the game executable this chain was found in.

address.description: Base address in hex, relative to a module ("MadMax.exe+17F7A10") or absolute.

offsets.description: Offsets in hex: at each step, read the pointer at the address and add the offset.
